settings.name: PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_IP
settings.description: Listening IP of the Prometheus exporter: *, a hostname or alias, an IPv4 address, or a bracketed IPv6 address such as [::1].

settings.name: PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_PORT
settings.description: Listening port of the Prometheus exporter.

settings.name: PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_URL
settings.description: HTTP URL of the Prometheus exporter.

settings.name: PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_ALLOW_IP
settings.description: List of IP/networks allowed to contact the Prometheus exporter endpoint.

settings.name: PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_TOKEN
settings.description: Bearer token required in the Authorization header to read the Prometheus exporter. Leave empty to disable the check. Use at least 16 characters and enable TLS so the token does not travel in clear.

settings.name: PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_SSL
settings.description: Serve the Prometheus exporter over TLS with the certificate set below. The exporter never falls back to plain HTTP.

settings.name: PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_SSL_CERT
settings.description: Full path of the exporter certificate or bundle file (must be readable by the scheduler). Used together with the key path, it wins over the data settings.

settings.name: PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_SSL_KEY
settings.description: Full path of the exporter private key file (must be readable by the scheduler).

settings.name: PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_SSL_CERT_DATA
settings.description: Exporter certificate data encoded in base64 or plaintext PEM format.

settings.name: PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_SSL_KEY_DATA
settings.description: Exporter private key data encoded in base64 or plaintext PEM format.
